options.label: Staged PRs (Recommended)

PR 3: split by the chosen shape, pure move, gated by a per-section diff. PR 4 and on: prune each new file against the ADR. Each step stays reviewable, and IDs and anchors carry over without loss.

options.label: ADR PR, then one rewrite
options.description: PR 1 as above. PR 2 moves status out, splits and prunes spec 003 in one go. Faster, but a 2,200-line diff with no move check; PR #1160 took 8 rounds for an RFC alone, so expect many rounds and missed relocations.

questions.question: Given that analysis, how should RFC-0022 Open Question 4 be closed?

options.label: Strict everywhere (Recommended)
options.description: Close OQ4 now: a type mismatch outranks missing_ok on every profile. The ADR records the decision and the analysis. Under D6 the probe becomes a line in each flat profile's cost statement (+1 round trip off the kernel, +2 on it, misses only). No behaviour or model change, and no new item.

options.label: Strict, plus opt-out flag
options.description: Strict by default, plus an opt-in such as delete(..., check_type=False) that skips the probe for bulk cleanup. This adds public API to every backend and the Store (a user.api change with tests and a CHANGELOG entry), so it would be filed as a feature item.

options.label: Tolerant on flat

Which of the Perplexity-derived changes should go into this branch before the PR opens?

options.label: Valid subset (Recommended)
options.description: SPEC-DESIGN Rule 2: classify a clause by what a witness of its violation looks like (one state; one input/output pair; a state, a call and its result; a sequence of calls on one object; a behaviour outside the library's control; an unbounded run), and a clause fitting two kinds goes to the larger witness. Rule 1: observable quality bounds are contract. Rule 4: reach is per section ID, derived from model @spec tags and spec marks. ADR: list the six kinds, add 'runs, does not block', lead the missing_ok Why with BE-012's reason, judge the cut in BK-456. No manifest and no rollback section.

options.label: Subset plus manifest
options.description: As above, plus a per-clause bridge-coverage field in each spec's front matter. This contradicts SPEC-DESIGN Rule 7 (no project state) and reverses a choice the earlier reviews declined; a hand field goes stale whenever a bridge or test changes.

options.label: Leave as is
options.description: Open the PR unchanged and let /rvw-pr rounds raise these points. The classification gap stays open until the first split, where it is most likely to cause inconsistent cuts.
